name: taskade
label: Taskade
description: Collaboration platform for remote teams to organize projects, tasks and AI agents.

token.label: Personal Token
token.description:
1. Go to https://www.taskade.com/settings/api (Settings > API).
	2. Under Personal Access Tokens, create a token with any name and copy it (it starts with tskdp_).

placement.label: Placement
placement.description: Where to add the task in the project.

get_project.label: Get Project
get_project.description: Gets a project by ID or link.

projectId.label: Project ID
projectId.description: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.

create_project.label: Create Project
create_project.description: Creates a project in a workspace or folder, optionally with tasks written as a Markdown list.

folderId.label: Workspace or Folder ID
folderId.description: A workspace ID or folder ID. A workspace ID works for its home folder. Get IDs from List Workspaces and List Folders.

content.label: Content (Markdown)
content.description: Optional. Each line starting with "- " becomes a task; indent with two spaces for subtasks.

create_project_from_template.label: Create Project from Template
create_project_from_template.description: Creates a project from one of your Taskade project templates.

folderId.label: Workspace or Folder ID
folderId.description: Where to create the project. A workspace ID works for its home folder.

templateId.label: Template ID
templateId.description: Get it from List Project Templates.

copy_project.label: Copy Project
copy_project.description: Copies a project, with its tasks, into a workspace or folder.

projectId.label: Project to Copy
projectId.description: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.

folderId.label: Workspace or Folder ID
folderId.description: Where to put the copy. A workspace ID works for its home folder.

projectTitle.label: New Title
projectTitle.description: Optional title for the copy. Leave empty to keep the original title.

get_task.label: Get Task
get_task.description: Gets a task with its date, note, assignees and custom field values.

projectId.label: Project ID
projectId.description: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.

includeDetails.label: Include Details
includeDetails.description: Also fetch the date, note, assignees and custom field values (4 more requests).

set_task_field_value.label: Set Custom Field Value
set_task_field_value.description: Sets or clears the value of a custom field on a task.

projectId.label: Project ID
projectId.description: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.

fieldId.label: Field ID
fieldId.description: Get it from List Custom Fields.

value.label: Value
value.description: Text, a number for number fields, or the option ID for Select fields. Required unless Clear Value is on.

clearValue.label: Clear Value
clearValue.description: Remove the value from the task. Value is ignored.

get_agent.label: Get AI Agent
get_agent.description: Gets an AI agent with its commands and their prompts.

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.description: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.

get_agent_conversation.label: Get Agent Conversation
get_agent_conversation.description: Gets one conversation of an AI agent, with its transcript.

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.description: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.

conversationId.label: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: Get it from List Agent Conversations.

generate_agent.label: Generate AI Agent
generate_agent.description: Creates a new AI agent from a plain-language description. Uses Taskade AI credits.

folderId.label: Workspace or Folder ID
folderId.description: A workspace ID or folder ID. A workspace ID works for its home folder. Get IDs from List Workspaces and List Folders.

description.label: What the Agent Should Do
description.description: For example: "An agent that drafts friendly replies to customer support emails".
